label: Arduino Sensor Shield v5.0
description: Arduino Sensor Shield v5.0 provides I2C interface, Bluetooth module communication interface, SD card module communication interface, APC220 wireless RF modules communication interface, RB URF V1.1 ultrasonic sensors interface, 12864 LCD serial and parallel interface, 32 servo controller interfaces. In addition (with the sel jumper removed) allows an external power supply for the servos as the Arduino can't provide enough power.
